question: The simple interest on a principal amount (in ₹) is ₹318 for a period of 2 years at the rate of 6% per annum. The principal amount (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total simple interest percentage for 2 years = 6% × 2 = 12%

⇒ 12% of Principal = 318

⇒ Principal (100%) = (318 ÷ 12) × 100 = 2650

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2650.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹318

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100
